product_title: Handcrafted Peacock Decorative Diya Holder Pair with Green Stonework and Golden Embellishments
product_description: Add a royal and traditional touch to your festive decorations with this beautifully designed Peacock Decorative Diya Holder Pair. Featuring elegant peacock motifs, intricate golden detailing, sparkling green stone embellishments, and ornate circular diya holders, this decorative pair showcases the beauty of traditional Indian craftsmanship. The rich combination of emerald green accents and golden finishes creates a luxurious appearance, making it perfect for enhancing your festive decor. Ideal for decorating pooja rooms, home temples, festive tables, and entranceways, these diya holders are perfect for Diwali, Lakshmi Puja, weddings, housewarming ceremonies, and other auspicious occasions. Bring elegance, cultural charm, and festive warmth to your home with this stunning decorative diya holder pair.
product_care_suggestion: Clean gently with a soft, dry cloth to remove dust.
Avoid washing or immersing the product in water to protect the decorative stones and golden finish.
Keep away from excessive moisture and humidity to maintain the product's appearance.
Avoid prolonged exposure to direct sunlight to preserve the vibrant colors and decorative finish.
Do not use harsh chemicals, detergents, or abrasive cleaning materials.
Handle the peacock motifs and stone embellishments carefully to prevent damage or detachment.
Store in a cool, dry place inside a protective box when not in use.
If using with a diya, ensure that the flame and heat remain well away from decorative stones and any non-metal decorative components. Never leave a burning diya unattended.
